checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Clip is 5 s, vertical 9:16, one continuous shot.

must.item: First scene reads 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
Second scene reads 'Plan your day in one place.'
Only those lines appear as visible text
must.why: None of the lines appear; the phone screen shows garbled pseudo-text.

must.item: Silent video with cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation
must.why: Video has sound (peak -2.7 dB), and it is a live-action woman with a colorful phone, not a cream-and-green animation.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: Wrong format: 5 s vertical instead of 9 s landscape with three scenes
Has voiceover and music although silent was required
Wrong style: photoreal live-action, not cream-and-green calendar/checkmark animation
Phone screen shows garbled gibberish text and icons
Low-res 480p; the phone and hand are slightly warped in motion

summary: The output is a generic 5 s vertical live-action clip with sound and garbled phone-screen text, and it misses every requirement: length, format, scenes, text, silence and style.
